summary: Qassimiut Heliport serves the tiny settlement of Qassimiut on the southern coast of Greenland, within the Kujalleq municipality. The heliport is a critical lifeline for this remote fishing community, connecting residents to larger service towns in the region. Helicopter operations are the primary means of reliable transport across the rugged, fjord-cut landscape of southern Greenland where fixed-wing airstrips are impractical.
